entries.title: Escrow and closing working group
entries.alt: People at a table with floor plans and a peer-to-peer property deal sketch

proof.acceptance: Attendance notes and the public working-group agenda.

entries.story: Sat with closing clerks and builders to map a peer-to-peer deal: list, deposit, inspect, hand over, release funds.

entries.title: Property escrow contract PR
entries.alt: Laptop showing a property escrow contract pull request

proof.acceptance: A public pull request: deposit, inspection window, release to seller.

entries.story: Wrote the contract that holds buyer funds until inspection and handover. A stranger can inspect the PR and read the rules.

entries.title: Testnet P2P listing
entries.alt: Phone showing a peer-to-peer property listing with a lock-deposit action

proof.acceptance: A testnet listing and a lock-deposit transaction.

entries.story: The working group and the escrow PR made a test listing possible: a house, a deposit button, no platform as middleman.

entries.title: Live P2P fulfillment
entries.alt: Keys and a tablet showing fulfillment complete

proof.acceptance: A mainnet fulfillment transaction and a recorded key handover.

entries.story: A real deal completed: deposit locked, inspection passed, keys handed over, funds released.

entries.title: Listing and handover UX
entries.alt: Paper wireframes of a property listing and fulfillment steps

proof.acceptance: Wireframes for listing, deposit, inspection, and handover.

entries.story: The same fulfillment also left a listing and handover design a merchant or buyer can follow.

entries.title: Clerk at live closings
entries.alt: A desk of closing folders, a stamp, and a house key

proof.acceptance: Closing files and a public log of which deals the clerk sat.

entries.story: Sat the desk at live closings: escrow, keys. The map of a deal came from the room, not from a course.

entries.title: Live P2P fulfillment, on site
entries.alt: Keys handed over at a house door, tablet in hand

proof.acceptance: A mainnet fulfillment transaction and a recorded key handover.

entries.story: Ran a real peer-to-peer deal on site: deposit locked, inspection passed, keys handed over, funds released. Did not write the contract.

entries.title: Second live fulfillment
entries.alt: Keys handed over on a brick townhouse stoop

proof.acceptance: A second mainnet fulfillment on a different property.

entries.story: A second real deal, a different house. Not a one-off.
